remarks: Here is a rare opportunity to own this character filled stone and brick Cape Cod style home. Updated beautifully over the past few years. The open concept main floor has great flow for entertaining. It is light and bright and is enhanced with impressive details throughout. The large living room with a wood burning fireplace draws you into the dining room showcasing built-in antique style cabinets. You can then either enter into the kitchen or go outside through the sliders to an impressive patio and yard. The kitchen is equipped with an open granite breakfast counter, a gas fired cooktop and stainless-steel appliances. The laundry room and half bath are off in the corner near the door to the one car garage. Up to the 2nd floor you will find the primary suite with a large walk-in closet and private bathroom with double sinks. Two other charmed-filled bedrooms and a hall bath complete the 2nd floor. The lower level is an added plus as it is nicely appointed for additional work, fitness or play space. Storage is available in the lower level or in the walk-up attic. Located in a prime Springdale location within walking distance to the trains and shopping center. This home is delightful and move in ready.
